# Emergent_Computation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The phenomenon where complex, intelligent behaviors arise from simple, local interactions among many computational units, without centralized control. Guides TCC/iNEST design toward distributed, self-organizing architectures that achieve high functionality with minimal energy and wiring complexity.
